newsitem.title: UK: UK shares firm at open, Zeneca up on new bid hopes.
newsitem.headline: UK shares firm at open, Zeneca up on new bid hopes.

text.p: UK shares nudged higher at the start of trading on Wedesday, reassured by a rebound to record highs on Wall Street and led by Zeneca Plc as the stock hit a new record peak in the latest bout of bid speculation.

The FTSE 100 was up 9.0 points at 4,033.4 by 0742 GMT, with gainers outweighing decliners by some three-to-one. Zeneca rose 23-1/2p to 17.11 stg, after reaching a peak of 17.15 stg, as press reports renewed talk of a bid from Switzerland's Roche.
Yet despite Wednesday's setback in the FTSE 100 from record highs reached earlier in the week, some strategists believe the current bull run is set to continue.
